source: ClimaClue worldwide 0.1° areas (CHELSA V2.1 1981–2010; ERA5-Land 1981–2010 for dew point and snow; CRU CL 2.0 about 1961–1990 for sunshine). Temperature, night lows, day highs, precipitation and wind at the town itself (its ~3 x 3 km, data/seo/town-points.json) where own = true, else the 0.1° area; sunshine, dew point and snow: the 0.1° area; hurs: relative humidity calculated from the dew point and the night lows and day highs (src/squares.ts). null = missing.
fields: ex_hi/ex_lo: 99th percentile of daily highs / 1st percentile of daily lows °C, 1981-2010, at the nearest qualifying weather station within 50 km (NOAA GHCN-Daily), ex_km its distance; cold/warm: coolest/warmest month mean °C; hi: warmest month average day high; lo: coldest month average night low; rain: mm a year; dry: months under 30 mm; sun: hours a year; wind: mean m/s; hum: mean relative humidity %; dew: muggiest month dew point °C; snow: fresh snow cm a year (1 mm water ≈ 1 cm); sea: km to the sea
